name: Human_TaskViewReset

disassembly: 0x004659F6  dd d8              fstp st(0)              ; pop the 1.0
semantics: Writes exactly three dwords into the object passed in [esp+4] and returns that same pointer in EAX: dword [+0x1EC] = 0, dword [+0x1E4] = 0x3F800000 (tan of the float-precision pi/4 at 0x005335E8), dword [+0x1E8] = 0x3F13CD3A (tan of the float-precision pi/6 at 0x005339C0). One basic block, no branches, no calls, no other memory written. The two constants are exactly the bit patterns retail stores, so the x87 fptan path is observed as a constant result, not as a floating-point tolerance.

candidate_implementation.semantic_note: engine/src/retail/human/human_view.cpp zeroes +0x1EC first, then stores the two computed float tangents at +0x1E4 and +0x1E8, and returns the argument; the two angles are the float-precision image constants promoted to double, so the stores produce the same bits as retail.
